items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: by and large we tried to stick to the, uh, New Orleans marching style bands, as I said before, Lewis and company, for our inspiration.

ctx.x: did, uh, you say Lewis Johnson, did any other bands have any influence on the band as a group?

Well, in view of the fact that there were seven people in the band who were playing for fun and had to be kept happy to stay in it, uh, and several members of the band could be termed perhaps Dixielanders if you didn't watch them, uh, I'd say, uh, possibly, uh, on the odd occasion an Eddie Condon influence or perhaps a Muggsy Spanier may have been able to creep in, but usually, uh, and even perhaps a Turk Murphy on some occasions, but, uh, by and large we tried to stick to the, uh, New Orleans marching style…
